scope: Standalone preview only; no production, API, auth, persistence or user-data changes.

fixes.issue: A single initial 100px pointer move escaped the 44px handle before capture, leaving width unchanged.
fixes.change: Listen for pointermove on window while a gesture is pending; capture only after horizontal intent is established.
fixes.retest: The same native mouse movement changed drawer width 1034→934px while held.

fixes.issue: An Escape/pointercancel followed by a delayed mouse release could outlive the 700ms click-suppression timeout and toggle unexpectedly.
fixes.change: Keep drag-click suppression until its resulting pointer click or the next deliberate pointerdown; keyboard activation remains allowed.
fixes.retest: Delayed releases after Escape, dispatched pointercancel and resize preserve the original open state.
